name: DWD Weather (Deutscher Wetterdienst)
description: DWD weather for Mittelfranken using DWD's public open-data services (ADR-0026): CAP 1.2 warnings, GeoServer WMS radar, POI observations. Target places Nürnberg / Fürth / Erlangen / Schwabach / Ansbach / Neustadt a.d. Aisch, each mapped to a warncell + POI station in config. Scaffold only — the data adapters are E18-02 (warnings), E18-03 (radar), E18-04 (observations); the get_* methods raise until then. Outbound HTTPS to opendata.dwd.de / maps.dwd.de only, no credentials.
